verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. Sequential verification found that the local-to-global extended-real convexity argument, the endpoint dichotomy and continuity, the convex extension and exact-collar smoothing, the uniform-to-decreasing extraction, and the interior approximation all justify the claimed sheaf equalities and fixed-domain approximation. The cited CLD25 statements were queried through the theorem index first and, after no exact indexed matches were returned, checked against the primary arXiv v2 PDF/source: Example 6.7.2 and Sections 6.1.1/6.1.6 with Definition 6.2.1 give precisely the finite-endpoint constant-collar smooth structure; the one-dimensional d'd'' formula gives f'' >= 0; Definition 8.1.1 and Lemmas 8.1.4 and 8.1.10 match every use. The proof correctly excludes the infinite endpoint/open-unit-disc model.
